speaker: george_bryan
text: Bow to the chair by the fire, whoever is in it. I said it on the step last night. I am saying it where the men are.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whoever is in it. We were not given a name. We will not spend the morning inventing one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the boy came. Four lines. Tuesday, Canon Row, by water at five, the king whole. No fifth line. I thanked him for that.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Whole. Then the leaves come out of the chest. I have not said them since June. I will not say them in this yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not in this yard. Tonight, on their floor, and then back into the chest. The afternoon is Egeon. The afternoon is not a rehearsal of the parliament.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick stays under the note he had on Saturday. The parlour is not a place to try a louder one.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hold it under the note, sir. I am not asking for a louder queen because the room is smaller.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Nine players and two boys. A floor the size of a counting-house. Twelve at table. Candles off our feet. A screen, and Garnish on a stool behind it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twelve I have from you. Five by water I have from the boy. The tide will not bring us home. The cart can take the boys and the baskets when the river is done. I am not pricing the cart before I see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Old Swan at five. The last of the flood. We will ask Davy for water. We will not ask him for news.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the glass?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If the room will bear it, thou wilt send for it, look, and do what the book says once. I am not teaching this yard the blow.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, we will know the purse when a purse is in the hand. I will not take a guess off a sum I have not held.

speaker: george_bryan
text: My lord is not the guest. The house is his daughter's husband's. We bow as if the chair were a presence. We do not ask the chair its business.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Kemp is not among the nine. He has no part in this king. I am not writing him one on the road to Westminster.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I did not ask for him. I asked for the leaves, and thou hast put them after dark. That will do.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Arthur with the Duchess, and Nick with the Queen. I am not swapping them because a room is small. The note Nick has is the note he keeps.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have the Queen. I will say her as I said her in Shoreditch, lower, for the panelling, not for fear of a chair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Lower, then. Not smaller. Thou comest when the cue is there. Tonight is not the orchard.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, clean bands, and no supper of ours before we go. They have eaten. We are the thing after the marchpane. The leaves stay in Garnish's hands until the door is shut.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Bow. I will say it twice in one morning and not a third time, unless a man stands as if the chair were empty furniture.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The chair is a chair until we are in the room. Then it is whoever is in it. Egeon at two. Gaunt after. We will not mix the rolls.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Egeon at two. The king after. I can keep them in different mouths. The two words stay where Humphrey put them. They are not a Westminster cue.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays in the orchard. Go and eat. Five is a tide, not a hope.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Five is a tide. I will be at the stairs. A man who is late will find the flood kept better time than he did.
